required_facts_checked: The writer used ChatGPT in dictation mode for brainstorming and outlined a possible AI Engineering Buildcamp continuation after the September 2025 cohort launched.
ChatGPT search, manual scrolling and keyword searches failed to locate the conversation.
The ChatGPT export was 775 MB, and its incomplete ZIP archive could not be opened by Windows even after two downloads.
Claude Code extracted important content, but conversations.json was about 155 MB and impractical to search manually.
ChatGPT Data Viewer was built overnight with Claude Code to visualize and search the history.
The interface idea was a GitHub-like contribution graph with date-based conversation views and planned API endpoints for statistics, contribution data and conversation lists.
The workflow used no tests or TDD, and the writer did not examine the code while Claude managed implementation.
The first working version stabilized in one or two iterations and took approximately two to three hours.
The architecture used FastAPI, a Vite-bundled vanilla JavaScript frontend, minsearch and one FastAPI server serving the frontend.
The archive contained 2,808 conversations and 45,247 messages spanning 2022-12-21 to 2026-02-06.
The lost Buildcamp conversation appeared in the first search results, and caching was added after initial indexing took time.
